meta.description: Create professional research posters in LaTeX using beamerposter, tikzposter, or baposter. Support for conference presentations, academic posters, and scientific communication. Includes layout design, color schemes, multi-column formats, figure integration, and poster-specific best practices for visual communication.

scientific_integrity.detail: Writing and visualization skill, not research methodology

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive coverage of 3 poster packages (beamerposter, tikzposter, baposter), 6-stage workflow, AI-powered visual generation with hard limits, and 8 detailed reference files

reliability.note: Good documentation of LaTeX compilation with overflow checks and QC procedure; version 1.6; minor: no explicit LaTeX distribution version requirements

performance_context.note: Well-structured 370-line SKILL.md with excellent progressive disclosure through 8 reference files; minor: density high, some content could move to references

agent_usability.note: Perfect trigger description with specific conference poster patterns; comprehensive 'When to Use' section with 8 use cases; mandatory AI graphics workflow clearly documented

human_usability.note: Excellent setup instructions with package installation (tlmgr/MiKTeX), system dependencies (pandoc, LaTeX), and complete 6-stage workflow from planning to delivery

security.note: Good handling of poster files and compilation; OpenRouter API key for AI generation noted; minor: no explicit guidance on handling malicious .tex files or template sources

maintainability.note: Perfect: version 1.6, license metadata, openclaw API key declaration, comprehensive reference structure with 8 files, templates in assets/

agent_specific.note: Strong composability with scientific-schematics skill integration; excellent progressive disclosure with 8 references; mandatory AI graphics workflow with hard limits; minor: error recovery for overflow could be more explicit

key_strengths: Exceptional AI graphics integration with mandatory visual elements (60-70% poster area), hard limits table (3-4 elements, 10 words, 50% white space), and two review gates

Excellent progressive disclosure with 8 detailed reference files covering AI graphics, LaTeX packages, compilation QC, poster patterns, layout, design principles, and content

Perfect integration with scientific-schematics skill marked as CRITICAL with generate-before-assemble workflow

recommendations.title: Add explicit AI graphic regeneration workflow for failures
recommendations.problem: Review gates check results but no explicit retry/regeneration workflow when AI produces wrong element count
recommendations.root_cause: Agent-specific composability focuses on success paths rather than failure recovery
recommendations.fix: Add to ai_graphics_for_posters.md: explicit regeneration workflow when AI ignores constraints (e.g., generates 7 elements instead of 3) with prompt adjustment strategies (add 'SIMPLER', 'EXACTLY 3 items', increase white space)

recommendations.title: Add explicit LaTeX distribution version requirements
recommendations.problem: Package installation shown but no minimum TeX Live or MiKTeX version specified
recommendations.root_cause: Reliability section focuses on compilation process rather than environment requirements
recommendations.fix: Add to package installation section: minimum TeX Live version (e.g., 2022+) or MiKTeX version with rationale, and note about older distributions missing required packages

recommendations.title: Add guidance on handling malicious .tex templates
recommendations.problem: Templates in assets/ mentioned but no security validation for external templates
recommendations.root_cause: Security section focuses on compilation but not template sourcing
recommendations.fix: Add to security section: guidance on validating external poster templates for \write18 commands, \input of external files, or other potentially dangerous LaTeX constructs
